comment: dokick.c really_kick_object() 783, 764 and 740: a debug Valkyrie level-teleports into Akalapi's general store on Dlvl 3 (seed from a port scan of 5520001-5520300 for a ^V arrival in a shop). She stashes 20 wished gold pieces in a wished bag, drops it (the shopkeeper credits the gold; she declines to sell the bag) and kicks it along the shop: the refund of contained gold runs donate_gold() (783). She drops a single wished gold piece in line with the door and, once the keeper has stepped off his post, kicks it out through the door, reducing her credit (costly_gold(), 764). Outside, she drops a wished pick-axe on the doorway, steps back and kicks it in; the keeper catches it (shkcatch()), and bhit() leaves no kicked object, so the kick returns at 740. 745 is not reached here.
